name: DSTP
title: The Echo of Arrow Glacier
tagline: A friendly spirit born and silenced on a single February day.

chapters.heading: The birth of dstp
paragraphs: Candles flicker near the image of the Arrow Glacier era. On February 6, 2022, the contract came into being. It is a small program that lives on Ethereum. A wallet ending in aea5 brought it into the world.
The contract was written in Solidity 0.8.7. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. It has lived for 4.7 years now.

chapters.heading: A quiet rest
paragraphs: The contract sits still now. It was last busy in 2022. Only 1 transaction ever moved through its gates.
People called setRoyalties once. It remains a ghost on the chain. No websites point to it today.

chapters.heading: The final echo
paragraphs: The code still rests on the chain like a stone in a garden. It has waited in silence for 4.7 years. No one has spoken to it since February 6, 2022.
The last call was setRoyalties. It sits now with 0.0 ETH left inside. The ghost of DSTP remains, still there but perfectly still.
